zh: Web 根目录是链接，未终止任何进程
en: The Web root is a link; no process was stopped.

zh: Web 根目录不属于本应用，未终止任何进程
en: The Web root is not owned by this app; no process was stopped.

zh: Web 根目录权限无法确认：%s
en: Cannot confirm Web root access: %s

zh: Web PID 文件异常，未终止任何进程
en: The Web PID record is invalid; no process was stopped.

zh: Web PID 无效，未终止任何进程
en: The Web PID is invalid; no process was stopped.

zh: Web 记录不属于本应用，未终止任何进程
en: The Web record is not owned by this app; no process was stopped.

zh: Web 记录权限无法确认：%s
en: Cannot confirm Web record access: %s

zh: 无法写入停止标记，尚未停止 Web
en: Cannot write the stop marker; Web has not been stopped.

zh: 进程信息超过核验上限
en: Process information exceeds the verification limit.

zh: 进程核验被中断
en: Process verification was interrupted.

zh: 检查 Web 进程失败（PID %s，errno=%s）
en: Failed to inspect the Web process (PID %s, errno=%s)

zh: 内核进程身份无法解析
en: Cannot parse the kernel process identity.

zh: 进程命令行暂不可读
en: The process command line is temporarily unreadable.

zh: 无法核验本应用进程：%s
en: Cannot verify this app process: %s

zh: Web 旧记录隔离目录异常，原环境保留
en: The old Web record quarantine is invalid; the environment is retained.

zh: 无法隔离旧 Web 记录，原环境保留
en: Cannot quarantine the old Web record; the environment is retained.

zh: Web 身份记录异常，原环境保留
en: The Web identity record is invalid; the environment is retained.

zh: 无法隔离旧 Web 身份记录，原环境保留
en: Cannot quarantine the old Web identity record; the environment is retained.

zh: Web 身份记录暂未保存：%s
en: The Web identity record could not be saved: %s

zh: Web 启动脚本仍在退出，已保留容器启动器
en: The Web startup script is still exiting; the container launcher is retained.

zh: Web 进程身份已变化，未终止其他进程，请重试
en: The Web process identity changed; no other process was stopped. Retry.

zh: Web 进程身份尚未确认，原环境保留：%s
en: The Web process identity is unconfirmed; the environment is retained: %s

zh: 隔离验证进程身份已变化，原现场保留
en: The isolated trial process identity changed; its original state is retained.

zh: 系统拒绝终止本次 Web，原环境保留
en: The system denied stopping this Web process; the environment is retained.

zh: Web 退出尚未确认，原环境保留：%s
en: Web exit is unconfirmed; the environment is retained: %s

zh: 已请求停止，Web 尚未退出；稍后可重试，未强杀容器启动器
en: Stop was requested but Web has not exited; retry later. The container launcher was not force-killed.

zh: 停止等待被中断，请检查 Web 状态
en: The stop wait was interrupted; check the Web state.

zh: 停止 Web 未完成：%s
en: Web stop is incomplete: %s

zh: 隔离验证停止未完成：%s
en: The isolated trial stop is incomplete: %s

zh: 隔离验证进程退出尚未确认，原现场保留
en: The isolated trial process exit is unconfirmed; its original state is retained.

zh: 本应用仍有未退出的 Web，原环境保留
en: This app still has a running Web process; the environment is retained.

zh: 本应用进程清单尚未确认，原环境保留：%s
en: This app process list is unconfirmed; the environment is retained: %s

zh: 无法核验本次 Web 停止候选，未终止任何进程：%s
en: Cannot verify this Web stop candidate; no process was stopped: %s

zh: 请先完成普通停止；只有退出尚未确认时才能准备强制停止候选
en: Complete the normal stop first; a force-stop candidate is available only while exit remains unconfirmed.

zh: Web 停止请求已变化，请重新检查当前状态
en: The Web stop request changed; check the current state again.

zh: Web 身份记录无效，原环境保留
en: The Web identity record is invalid; the environment is retained.

zh: 隔离验证进程不可读取，原现场保留
en: The isolated trial process is unreadable; its original state is retained.

zh: 已知 Web 启动器未能确认退出
en: The known Web launcher has not been confirmed to exit.
